official: 令和七年度分の都及び特別区並びに特別区相互間の財政調整の特例に関する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: 都区財政調整の単位費用を引き上げ
summary: 都と特別区の間や特別区どうしの財政調整では、条例に定めた単位費用が計算の基礎になっています。令和7年度分に限り、この単位費用の一部を引き上げます。公布の日から施行します。
changes: 財政調整の計算に使う単位費用の一部を引き上げる
why: 令和7年度分の都と特別区の間や特別区どうしの財政調整を再計算する必要があるためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Raises unit costs for financial adjustment between Tokyo and the special wards
en.official: Ordinance on Special Provisions for the Financial Adjustment for Fiscal Year 2025 Between the Tokyo Metropolitan Government and the Special Wards, and Among the Special Wards
en.summary: Unit costs set by ordinance form the basis for calculating financial adjustments between the Tokyo Metropolitan Government and the special wards, and among the special wards. For fiscal year 2025 only, some of these unit costs will be raised. The ordinance takes effect on the date it is promulgated.
changes: Raises some of the unit costs used to calculate financial adjustments
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says this is because the financial adjustments for fiscal year 2025 between the Tokyo Metropolitan Government and the special wards, and among the special wards, need to be recalculated.
